meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will route the specified agent group to a local Ollama model instead of calling the Anthropic API. It adjusts container config and model settings, and can optionally block access to Anthropic servers.
howto.when_en: When you want to run your agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models, provided Ollama is installed and a model is pulled. You need to specify the agent group and model name.
